HOW TO PLAY

1️⃣

Explore the Village

Use WASD to walk and Mouse to orbit camera. Walk to the broken river bridge.

2️⃣

Enter Build Mode

Press [E] near the bridge to open the Builder. Camera lifts into tactical perspective.

3️⃣

Snap & Rotate Bridge Decks

Select ROAD or BRIDGE. Hover near glowing sockets. Press [R] to rotate parallel to road, and click to place.

4️⃣

Test the Route

Click TEST. If route access < 100%, read the hint and adjust. At 100%, the ambulance drives across!

5️⃣

Next Area Unlocked

When ambulance reaches hospital, District 2 gate opens so you can continue exploring.
